name: Zysax

abilities.name: Molten Rain
abilities.description: Zysax makes molten cold fire rain on all players in small areas for a moment, each dealing high frost damage. Some of those areas leave a larger flaming area dealing continuous direct moderate frost damage, each hit adding 100 frost damage against you (This resets for every cast of Molten Rain).

abilities.name: Scourge Bolt
abilities.description: Zysax spits a coldfire bolt at all targets in front of him, each dealing high flame damage.

abilities.name: Coldfire Storm
abilities.description: Zysax flies still then fires a constant torrent of lightning in an area dealing continuous direct moderate flame damage. During this, many projectiles travel along the ground in all directions from the point of impact, each dealing moderate flame damage.

abilities.name: Strike
abilities.description: Basic melee attack dealing high physical damage.

abilities.name: Backhand
abilities.description: Basic melee attack dealing moderate physical damage.

abilities.name: Monstrous Cleave
abilities.description: Zysax swipes in front of him with its two hands, dealing extreme physical damage, knocking back and stunning in a cone. This can be blocked to be staggered instead.

abilities.name: Fly/Relocate
abilities.description: When Zysax is at the Soul Spire's entrance, he can relocate to a perch in the northeast or southwest, dealing extreme physical damage in an area upon landing. Zysax can then relocate between the two perches. After some time, he will fly back to the Soul Spire's entrance.

abilities.name: Wing Gust
abilities.description: When Zysax is on the perches, he gets down on the ground and raises its wings, then unleashes a powerful gust launching nearby targets away.

abilities.name: Soul Tear
abilities.description: Zysax shouts and all targets in range are linked to him via brief blue links. Targets are dealt moderate magic damage over time, applied extreme Heal Absorption and are applied the "Corrupting Defile" debuff which reduces your healing and damage shield strength, all three for 16 seconds.

dialogue.line: In death, you will serve. The Soul Spire is ever hungry.
dialogue.trigger: Upon your approach, Zysax will say

dialogue.line: There is no escape. Your souls shall remain in the Writhing Fortress forever!
dialogue.trigger: Upon your approach, Zysax will say

dialogue.line: I will end you swiftly. The Writhing Wall needs more souls.
dialogue.trigger: Upon your approach, Zysax will say

dialogue.line: Have you brought enough to defeat me?
I grow bored with your lack of courage.
Did you think you could escape unscathed?

dialogue.trigger: When Zysax moved from its perch, it would say

dialogue.line: We are not through yet, mortals!
dialogue.trigger: When Zysax moved from its perch, it would say

dialogue.line: You can run but you cant [sic] hide!
The eye of the storm is upon you!

dialogue.speaker: Zysax
dialogue.line: Its [sic] not over, it will end soon enough!
dialogue.trigger: When it falls in battle, Zysax shouts

dialogue.speaker: Prince Azah
dialogue.line: Good riddance! Head for the spire, comrades. Walks-in-Ash and I will join you inside.

related_quests: Support the Fellowship: Assist the Stirk Fellowship during the Battle for the Writhing Wall. (disabled)
summary: Zysax is a giant Daedric Titan and the final boss of the Writhing Fortress, he will be guarding entrance the Soul Spire which is powering the Writhing Wall back on Nirn. He is found at the end of the Soul Spire Path, which is accessible once the guardians of the eastern and western wings have been slain.
